title: First Earth Battalion sergeant kills a goat with his mind, steals a helicopter and disappears

tellings.quote: uh, the guy who did did kill the goat experienced dying with the goat.

plain: A sergeant in the First Earth Battalion, an unusual Army idea for soldiers trained in mental and psychic skills, is said to have killed a goat with his mind, and to have "experienced dying with the goat," before stealing a helicopter and disappearing. Lyn Buchanan, a former Army sergeant who did psychic spying work, tells Michels this as he heard it from Jim Channon, the Army officer behind the battalion. If true, it would mean the Army's mind experiments produced real and deeply disturbing effects.
